Get TPBL Roster

Source: R/tpbl.R
tpbl_roster.Rd

The registered roster of one team in one division (birth dates omitted).

Endpoint: GET https://api.tpbl.basketball/api/divisions/{division_id}/teams/{team_id}/players

Usage

tpbl_roster(division_id, team_id)

Arguments

division_id

Required. TPBL division id (one competition phase of one season: 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 = 2024-25 preseason, regular season, playoffs, postseason challenge, finals; 8, 9, 11, 12, 35 = 2025-26; 655, 656 = 2026-27); division_id in tpbl_divisions. Not the GoHoops division id.

team_id

Required. TPBL team id (the franchise, 2-8, stable across seasons); team_id in tpbl_teams. Not the GoHoops id.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: The registered roster of one team in one division (birth dates omitted). An empty answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py tpbl_roster):

col_nametypedescription
division_idintegerTPBL division id (key space: TPBL divisions, one competition phase of one season; 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 = 2024-25, 8, 9, 11, 12, 35 = 2025-26, 655, 656 = 2026-27): the {division_id} of every division route. Not the GoHoops division id.
team_idintegerTPBL team id (key space: TPBL teams = franchises, 2-8 so far; stable across seasons): the {team_id} of the division team routes. Not the GoHoops franchise id and not the squad id.
teamcharacterTeam name in Traditional Chinese with the sponsor (Kaohsiung Aquas, Formosa Dreamers, Hsinchu Lioneers, Taoyuan Leopards, New Taipei CTBC DEA, New Taipei Kings, Taipei Mars).
player_idintegerTPBL player id (key space: TPBL players; one per person across seasons and teams): the {player_id} of the player routes. Not the GoHoops person id and not the roster id.
gohoops_person_idintegerGoHoops person id (key space: GoHoops persons; one per human). Not the TPBL player id and not the roster id.
gohoops_roster_idintegerGoHoops roster id (key space: GoHoops rosters = one player registered with one squad in one season; it changes when the player changes season or team). The key of the box score players: join tpbl_box_players to tpbl_roster on it. Not the TPBL player id and not the person id.
gohoops_squad_idintegerGoHoops squad id (key space: GoHoops squads = one team in one season: 8209-8215 in 2024-25, 11931-11937 in 2025-26, 15536-15542 in 2026-27; it changes every season).
gohoops_event_idintegerGoHoops event id (key space: GoHoops events, one per TPBL season; 319 = 2024-25, 490 = 2025-26, 613 = 2026-27). Not the TPBL season id and not the GoHoops season id.
gohoops_season_idintegerGoHoops season id (key space: GoHoops seasons, the id system the API echoes beside its own; 101 = 2024-25, 213 = 2025-26, 275 = 2026-27). Not the TPBL season id.
playercharacterPlayer name (Traditional Chinese, or a transliteration for foreign players).
alt_namecharacterRomanized name (e.g. 'Chian Kuang-Chien'); ” when none.
numbercharacterJersey number as text (so '0' and '00' stay distinct).
positioncharacterPlaying position as a PascalCase enum: PointGuard, ShootingGuard, SmallForward, PowerForward, Center, and the combinations PointGuardAndShootingGuard, ShootingGuardAndSmallForward, SmallForwardAndPowerForward and PowerForwardAndCenter; ” when unset.
height_cmintegerHeight in centimetres.
weight_kgdoubleWeight in kilograms (a number; fractions possible).
nationalitycharacterNationality text: 'Local' for a Taiwan-born player, ” when unset.
national_identitycharacterPlayer category: 'Local' (Taiwanese), ” when unset (foreign and naturalized categories use other strings).
national_identity_detailcharacterFree-text detail on the category; ” in every sample.
registeredlogicalTrue when the player is registered with the squad.
is_listinglogicalTrue when the player is shown on the team's public roster page.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in tpbl_seasons().

See also

Other TPBL Functions: tpbl_box_player_periods(), tpbl_box_players(), tpbl_box_team_periods(), tpbl_box_teams(), tpbl_divisions(), tpbl_game(), tpbl_games(), tpbl_player_games(), tpbl_player_shots(), tpbl_referees(), tpbl_seasons(), tpbl_standings(), tpbl_standings_against(), tpbl_team_shots(), tpbl_teams()
